description: This file implements WAN management functions, including mode setting, interface configuration, and event handling for a network device. It manages WAN modes, interface IP modes, and responds to events related to WAN and interface changes.

methods.name: wan_get_dm
methods.description: Returns the current WAN manager data model object.

methods.name: wan_get_parser
methods.description: Returns the current parser object for WAN management.

methods.name: _wan_manager_main
methods.description: Initializes or cleans up WAN management context based on reason code.

methods.name: change_wan_mode_values
methods.description: Modifies WAN mode list string based on operation (set, add, remove).

methods.name: manipulate_mode
methods.description: Sets or modifies WAN mode and operation mode, handles autosensing.

methods.name: _setWANMode
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode.

methods.name: _WANModeEnable
methods.description: Enables a WAN mode.

methods.name: _WANModeDisable
methods.description: Disables a WAN mode.

methods.name: set_intf_ip_mode
methods.description: Sets IP mode (IPv4 or IPv6) for a network interface object.

methods.name: _setIPv4Mode
methods.description: Configures IPv4 mode for a specified interface.

methods.name: _setIPv6Mode
methods.description: Configures IPv6 mode for a specified interface.

methods.name: _Reset
methods.description: Resets WAN mode to current state.

methods.name: _getWANMode
methods.description: Retrieves current WAN mode configuration details.

methods.name: _set_wan_mode
methods.description: Event handler to set WAN mode based on event data.

methods.name: _check_wan_mode
methods.description: Validates a list of WAN modes for compatibility and correctness.

methods.name: _interface_already_configured
methods.description: Checks if an interface is already configured with a specific name.

methods.name: _dm_wan_manager_physical_type_changed
methods.description: Handles event when WAN physical type changes.

methods.name: _dm_wan_manager_wan_added
methods.description: Handles event when a new WAN is added.

methods.name: _wan_destroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a WAN interface object is destroyed.

methods.name: _interface_destroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an interface object is destroyed.
